facts.claim: Uber's mission is to reimagine movement for the better.
facts.quote: We reimagine the way the world moves for the better

facts.claim: Uber aims to be a fully electric, zero-emission platform by 2040.
facts.quote: Uber is committing to becoming a fully electric, zero-emission platform by 2040

facts.claim: Uber Eats allows users to order from restaurants and grocery stores.
facts.quote: Order from your favorite restaurants and grocery stores, online or with the Uber app.

facts.claim: Uber Freight matches carriers with shippers via a free app.
facts.quote: Uber Freight is a free app that matches carriers with shippers.

facts.claim: Uber operates in over 70 countries globally.
facts.quote: Our technology helps people connect and move in over 70 countries and 15,000+ cities around the world.

facts.claim: Uber emphasizes doing the right thing for riders, drivers, and employees.
facts.quote: We’re building a culture within Uber that emphasizes doing the right thing, period, for riders, drivers, and employees.

signals.text: Emphasize global scale and large-scale platform systems.
Highlight commitment to sustainability and zero-emission goals.
